name: Scattered Petals of the Thousand-Toothed Blossom

system.description:
Artifact N/A. One of the four directional Titans--massive First Age aerial citadels that embodied the gratuitous pinnacle of the Old Realm's aerial fleet. This is the Titan of the Eastern direction, thought lost in the Wyld millennia ago but actually dormant beneath the Ravanashi Peaks as the mountain now known as Mount Metagalapa. Named as a perpetual insult to the Primordial Metagaos. In standard flight mode, the pentagonal ziggurat hull stretches more than five miles at its widest point and a mile from base to peak, allowing it to shade an entire city beneath it. It can also expand into a siege configuration eight miles across. Most of the superstructure is built from living stone monoliths symbiotically grafted onto a magitech skeleton of jade alloy, allowing the hull to regenerate and perform limited autonomic upkeep.

Speed: 10/20mph (5/10mph while shielded or in siege configuration). Maneuverability: -4S (Lore 5, Sail 5). Crew: 5,000 (minimum skeleton 2,000; requires functional AI and Solar commander attuned to hologlyphic control dais for 10 motes). Cargo: Effectively unlimited, city-sized complex of hangars, vaults, laboratories and barracks. Armor: 60L/60B. Ablative Essence shield (when activated): solid to dematerialized beings, completely impervious to Shaping effects, Hardness 100L/100B; any attack that penetrates it collapses the barrier without damaging the Titan and the shield cannot be reactivated until receiving Repair 5 maintenance.

Health Levels: Ux200/Mx100/Cx50/Ix30/D (each attack cannot inflict more damage levels than the attacker's Essence or artifact weapon's rating, whichever is higher; large area attacks encompassing most of the vessel's volume inflict damage normally).

Weapons: 500 Essence Beam Cannons (Speed 5, Accuracy [gunner's Wits + Archery + 2], Damage 15L piercing [damages everything within five yards of impact; affects dematerialized beings normally], Range 1 mile, Rate 1; roughly 100 cannons can converge fire on any point; commander can remotely fire any cannon from the hologlyphic control dais). Eye of Judgment superweapon (Speed 7; opening the hull or returning to flight mode takes 10 minutes; Accuracy Perfect--fires a one-mile-wide pillar of light straight down; Damage 100L levels of piercing [aggravated to creatures of darkness; permanently obliterates killed spirits and sears deceased mortal souls into Lethe; expanding holocaust ripple to a radius of five miles, 100 yards high, damages everything material and immaterial not protected by a perfect defense]; Range special; Rate 1/hour [day] or 1/night [using the commander's anima rather than sunlight]). Also carries 50 thousand-forged dragon launch silos and hangars for hundreds of skyships.

The living stone armor heals itself (one bashing level per week, one lethal per month, one aggravated per year) and protects inhabitants against Wyld exposure up to Middlemarches-strength. Powers itself by draining ambient Essence via millions of miles of respiration microfilaments: in flight mode, all manses and demesnes within 25 miles are treated as one rating lower; in siege mode, drain increases to two dots and temporarily disables hearthstones from drained manses. Cannot stay aloft in Essence-dead areas without major refitting. Each of the four directional Titans also contained a full factory-cathedral-equivalent workshop with archival templates of every important artifact and comprehensive biotemplates. Requires Repair 6 maintenance every week by a 100-member team (or once per month while suspended in a paramagnetic web). Each missed upkeep disables systems in order: auxiliary systems, siege mode, energy shield, Essence cannons, maneuvering engines, then AI. If the AI is disabled, the fortress exists in depleted hibernation as an inert mountain held aloft only by sufficiently strong geomancy.
